explanation: Nick Park began the first film, A Grand Day Out (1989), as a film student. Gromit has no mouth, so he acts with his eyes and brow alone.

claims.text: Wallace and Gromit were created by Nick Park and are made by Aardman Animations of Bristol.
Laika, Cosgrove Hall and Will Vinton Studios did not create Wallace and Gromit.
Nick Park began A Grand Day Out as a film student, and it was completed in 1989.
Gromit has no mouth and expresses himself with his eyes and brow.

issues.note: The stem says the studio 'created' Wallace and Gromit. Strictly, Nick Park created them as a student at the National Film and Television School and finished the first film at Aardman, which has made them ever since. No other option fits, so the key stands; 'Which studio makes the Wallace and Gromit films?' would be exact.
